prefix.description: SEL-9L Line Relay (SEL 9 Series relay platform)

part_number.note: No configurable per-digit Model Option Table is published for the SEL-9L. It is the first relay in the new SEL 9 Series platform; the only available document is a preliminary data sheet, which describes feature-based / preconfigured 'Popular Models' ordering rather than a legacy fixed-column part number. No genuine part numbers were found in the data sheet, instruction manuals, or RDB uploads to calibrate positions against. Emit no decodable positions until an SEL-9L Ordering Information (Model Option Table) document is published.
references: SEL-9L Line Relay Data Sheet (9L_DS_20250829.pdf, Date Code 20260514, Preliminary Copy--Subject to Change)
